correctness.rationale: The proof establishes equivalence with decorated leaf preorders for every finite width by direct checking of all three relational conditions under reflexivity and pathwise transitivity in both directions. Quotient-by-equivalence, the predecessor ideal and greatest class are reconstructible. The Stirling decomposition and Burnside fixed-weight cycle identity prove the two full-family formulas. An independent direct enumeration checks all reflexive relations through four leaves against the original relational axioms, and the poset-based implementation checks coefficients through five leaves.

value.rationale: The first branching finite Gödel forests supply a natural nonchain test bed for combining Fischer Servi and Dunn compatibility with S4-style modal preorder conditions. A full structural classification and two exact enumerators for every width, including orbit counts, go beyond isolated computation and give a reusable reduction to weighted posets with ideals.
